newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney details Chrysler cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney details Chrysler cut.

text.p: -- Smith Barney confirmed analyst David Garrity downgraded Chrysler Corp to neutral from buy.
-- In a research note, Garrity cited "prospective profit margin pressure stemming from sport-utility vehicle overproduction in Q1 97 and product changeover costs" in the second and third quarters.
-- Recommended swapping into General Motors Corp until Chrysler's margin pressure abates.
-- Set target price at $28 per share. Left 1997 earnings estimate at $5.30 per share, noting that Chrysler's aggressive share repurchases may limit declines in earnings per share.

-- "Despite lower shares outstanding ... we expect Q3 and Q4 EPS to show year/year declines and note that our Q2 forecast ($1.45 vs $1.38) is at risk because of the current Mount Road engine plant strike..."
-- Chrysler shares fell 3/8 to 28-1/4, GM shares rose one to 54-5/8.
